WITH filtered_date_dim AS (
    SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1999 AND d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10
),
materialized_store_sales AS (
    SELECT ss_item_sk, ss_store_sk, MAX(ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN filtered_date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    GROUP BY ss_item_sk, ss_store_sk
),
materialized_store_returns AS (
    SELECT sr_item_sk, sr_customer_sk, MAX(sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss
    FROM store_returns
    JOIN filtered_date_dim ON sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
    GROUP BY sr_item_sk, sr_customer_sk
),
materialized_catalog_sales AS (
    SELECT cs_item_sk, MAX(cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN filtered_date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    GROUP BY cs_item_sk
)
SELECT i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name,
       COALESCE(ms.store_sales_profit, 0) AS store_sales_profit,
       COALESCE(mr.store_returns_loss, 0) AS store_returns_loss,
       COALESCE(mc.catalog_sales_profit, 0) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM item i
JOIN store s ON i.i_item_sk = s.s_store_sk
LEFT JOIN materialized_store_sales ms ON i.i_item_sk = ms.ss_item_sk AND s.s_store_sk = ms.ss_store_sk
LEFT JOIN materialized_store_returns mr ON i.i_item_sk = mr.sr_item_sk AND s.s_store_sk = (SELECT ss_store_sk FROM store_sales WHERE ss_customer_sk = mr.sr_customer_sk)
LEFT JOIN materialized_catalog_sales mc ON i.i_item_sk = mc.cs_item_sk
ORDER BY i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name
LIMIT 100

raw_sql: select i_item_id ,i_item_desc ,s_store_id ,s_store_name ,max(ss_net_profit) as store_sales_profit ,max(sr_net_loss) as store_returns_loss ,max(cs_net_profit) as catalog_sales_profit from store_sales ,store_returns ,catalog_sales ,date_dim d1 ,date_dim d2 ,date_dim d3 ,store ,item where d1.d_moy = 4 and d1.d_year = 1999 and d1.d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk and i_item_sk = ss_item_sk and s_store_sk = ss_store_sk and ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk and ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk and ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number and sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk and d2.d_moy between 4 and 10 and d2.d_year = 1999 and sr_customer_sk = cs_bill_customer_sk and sr_item_sk = cs_item_sk and cs_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk and d3.d_moy between 4 and 10 and d3.d_year = 1999 group by i_item_id ,i_item_desc ,s_store_id ,s_store_name order by i_item_id ,i_item_desc ,s_store_id ,s_store_name limit 100
